# möbius for macOS 0.3.9

- Switching chats quickly no longer shows "open this chat on the connection before controlling it".
- A chat opens behind its loading face until its whole history is here, instead of filling in turn by turn.
- The Bot conversation keeps the chat controls in the titlebar like every chat, with the plain dots button.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later, and gateway 0.16.3 (protocol 88).
